extraction_notes: Scanned PDF (EPSON Scan, no text layer); the page images were extracted with pypdf and the tables transcribed by reading the images. The report names the system 'Emerald Estates Mutual Water Company' (Drinking Water Watch: Emerald Valley Mutual Water Company, CA4301004; same operator contact Michael F. Maggiora and same wells EVE-1/EVE-2). The title is '2025 Consumer Confidence Report' and all sample dates are in 2025, but the 'About This Report' template sentence still says the monitoring period was January 1 to December 31, 2024; data_year recorded as 2025. Tables 3-5 list a separate row per well (EVE-1, EVE-2), recorded as source_group values. The 'Range of Detections' column is misused (prints units or a single number), so where the Level Detected cell itself is a range (nitrate, EVE-2 iron) the range is recorded in range_low/range_high with value = range high. Table 2 (lead/copper) was never filled in. EVE-2 iron reaches 680 against the printed SMCL 300 with no asterisk. Table 6 (unregulated) is empty; Table 7 and Table 9 print 'None'; the Special Notice boxes and Tables 10/11 and the Level 1/Level 2 assessment sections (pages 7-9) are unfilled State template text, not system-specific disclosures.
